s0: Welcome. In the next few minutes you will see how to run Kalwings as an admin, and how the code is organised for developers.
s1.r0: Real people only, with consent. Never add a student or mentor who has not agreed to be listed.
s1.r1: Pay, mode, location, eligibility. Always shown on every listing. Unpaid roles say so.
s1.r2: Student contact stays private. Unless the student chooses to share it.
s1.r3: No invented numbers. No made-up stats, logos, awards or testimonials.
s1.r4: People decide. No auto-rejection. Scores are advice. No guaranteed jobs.
s3.n1: Open the login page and type your email address.
s3.n2: Press Send one-time code. There are no passwords: a six-digit code is emailed to you.
s4.n1: Type the six-digit code from your inbox. It works for 10 minutes.
s4.n2: Press Log in. You land in your workspace.
s5.n1: Directory: companies, colleges, mentors and users live here.
s5.n2: Bulk upload: add many students, companies or mentors from a spreadsheet.
s5.n3: Launch readiness: a live checklist of what is still missing.
s6.n1: Add a company yourself: name, website, status and plan.
s6.n2: Search by name, or filter by status.
s6.n3: Open a company to manage it.
s7.n1: Edit details, upload a logo, set the career page address.
s7.n2: Verification: only verified companies can post and search.
s7.n4: Team: add an HR person by name and email. They sign in with an emailed code.
s8.t: Post a listing for a company.
s8.n1: Fill title, type, description, pay, mode, location, eligibility and deadline. Pay is mandatory.
s8.n2: Listings appear here. Close or reopen any time.
s9.n1: Add a college and verify it so students can pick it.
s9.n2: Edit a college whenever you need to.
s10.n1: Add a mentor with every detail: role, company, country, domain, topics and bio.
s10.n2: Edit later, or upload a photo for them. The mentor can update their own profile after signing in.
s11.n2: Add anyone: student, mentor, HR at another company, college admin or admin.
s11.n3: Change role: the account and all its data stay exactly as they were.
s11.n1: Role requests from users wait here. Approve or decline.
s11.n4: Search by name or email. Suspending is reversible and never deletes anyone.
s12.n1: In Settings, a user picks the role they need...
s12.n3: ...and sends the request. Nothing changes until an admin approves.
s13.n1: Three panels: students, companies and mentors.
s13.n2: Each takes an Excel or CSV file, up to 1,000 rows.
s13.n3: Mentors need role, company, country and domain as well as name and email.
s14.n1: Download the template and keep its first row.
s14.n3: Preview saves nothing. Every row shows ready, skipped or error.
s14.n5: Two ready, one error. Fix it or leave it out.
s14.n4: Import adds only the ready rows. One bad row never blocks the others.
s15.n2: Set the price text employers see.
s15.n4: Change the four limits: listings, challenges, assessments, team.
s15.n5: Save: every company on the plan sees it at once.
s16.n3: Press a plan button to switch a company. Its team is notified.
s17.n1: An announcement banner for every signed-in page.
s17.n2: The support email shown on Help and Contact.
s17.n3: Untick a role to close sign-ups for it.
s18.n2: If sign-in emails are not ticked, nobody can receive codes. Fix that first.
s18.n3: Real companies, colleges, mentors and listings: each line links to where you fix it.
s19.n3: Approve or reject new listings. Check pay, mode, location and eligibility are honest.
s20.n3: Every admin decision is recorded: who, what and when. Entries cannot be edited.
s22.a: A request travels from the browser to a Next dot js page, then through Prisma to the database.
s22.b: On every request the page checks the session cookie and reads the user again from the database.
s22.c: So a suspended account, or a changed role, applies on the very next click.
s23.t: Every server action follows six steps.
s23.k0: requireActionRole. Who is calling? First line of every action.
s23.k1: zod validate. Check and cap every input on the server.
s23.k2: Business rules. Return friendly errors, do not throw.
s23.k3: Prisma write. Scope queries to the owner.
s23.k5: revalidatePath. Refresh pages and return a result.
s24.k1: prisma migrate diff. Generate the SQL from your local database.
s24.k2: Add migration.sql. New timestamped folder. Never edit an old one.
s24.k3: embed-migrations. Compile the SQL into the build. Commit the generated file.
s24.k4: migrate deploy. Apply and check for drift.
s24.k5: docs:db and docs:api. Regenerate docs, then commit together.
s25.a: Before every pull request, run lint, typecheck, unit tests, the build, and the end to end suite.
s25.b: Continuous integration then repeats the checks on My S Q L eight and Maria D B ten point eleven.
s25.c: Merge to main. Hostinger builds, migrations apply on start, and you confirm the health endpoint.
s26: Read the full manual. Every step, with labelled screenshots, is in the P D F.
